concerns.text: FR-001 (generate proofs/grids with sympy/networkx) and SC-005 (validity rate ≥ 99%) lack complete implementation coverage. T011 and T012 are unchecked, and T015 (validation script) is unchecked. While T015b exists, it relies on T015. The 'Independent Test' for US1 requires verifying validity, which cannot be done without the unchecked T015 script.

FR-002 (training loop with parity checks) and SC-002 (exact parity of rule evaluations) are not fully covered. T022 (parity_checker.py) and T023 (training loop logic) are unchecked. T018-T020 (agent implementations) are also unchecked. The plan requires these to ensure 'equal data exposure', but the tasks are marked incomplete.

FR-005 (calculate forgetting rate) and FR-006 (ANOVA/Tukey tests) are not covered by checked tasks. T026, T027, T031, T032, and T033 are all unchecked. SC-001, SC-003, and SC-004 depend on these implementations. The 'Independent Test' for US3 cannot be executed without these unchecked tasks.

FR-004 (evaluate against held-out test sets) is not explicitly covered by a checked task. T013 generates held-out instances, but no task explicitly implements the evaluation logic against them for US3. T026 calculates metrics but relies on evaluation data not yet generated by a checked task.

FR-003 (Co-evolving mode with bidirectional exchange) is not covered by a checked task. T020 (CoevolvingAgent) is unchecked. The 'Independent Test' for US2 requires verifying bidirectional exchange, which cannot be done without T020.

SC-005 (validity rate ≥ 99%) requires a validation script (T015) that is unchecked. T015b executes the validation but depends on T015. Without T015, the pipeline cannot enforce the 'Verified Accuracy' gate required by the Constitution before training begins.

SC-002 (exact parity of rule evaluations) relies on T022 (parity_checker.py) and T023, both of which are unchecked. The core experimental constraint of 'equal data exposure' cannot be enforced or verified without these tasks.

T039b (unit tests for statistical validity) is listed as an implementation task, but since the statistical analysis module itself (T027) and the data it processes are unchecked, this test task cannot be executed or verified, representing a dependency failure in the test strategy.
